title: docs(skills): objectstack-ui teaches that a select badge is coloured only when its option declares color
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao5v13WT1hqhQVEQQGiYPr2F)_

Fixes #37406

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:用 AI 搭应用的人,让 AI 给下拉选项(如状态、优先级)上色时,AI 会直接在选项上写明颜色;以前技能里没讲这件事,AI 可能以为颜色会自动出现,结果界面一片灰。
- 为什么做:属于「下拉选项颜色只认声明」这次裁决(「A 全部去掉，没配就灰」)的收尾,界面已改完,这里补上对外技能里的那一句说明。
- 出错会怎样:只多了一句说明文字,不改任何运行行为;写错了最多是 AI 少配或多配颜色,直接撤回这次合并即可。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md`, under Column Features: one sentence. A `select` badge is coloured only when its option declares `color`, with the tiny option shape, the accepted values, and "any other option renders neutral".
- `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: the `list-views.md` row moves 4448 to 4510, pinned at the measurement, with the provenance comment.
- `.changeset/37406-ui-skill-select-option-colour.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch.

The accepted values were read from the renderer, not from the card: `BADGE_COLOR_MAP` in `ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx` keys exactly `gray`, `red`, `orange`, `yellow`, `green`, `blue`, `indigo`, `purple`, `pink`; `resolveColorName` passes those through and sends a value starting with `#` to the hex path; everything else, no declaration included, falls to `NEUTRAL_BADGE_CLASSES` in `getBadgeColorClasses`. The sentence claims that and no more.

Nothing was removed: on `origin/main` 0b539b6a, `grep -rniE 'colou?r' skills/objectstack-ui` has no line about a select option's colour and none implying a colour derived from the value, so the card's "remove or correct" half had nothing to act on.

### Why the ratchet row rises instead of being paid by deletion

The file sat at zero headroom, and the standing ruling on this ratchet is 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」. There is no restatement to cut for this sentence: option colour was untaught in the skill (0 hits), so nothing in the file says the same thing twice. The raise runs on the ratchet header's other clause, "a ruling of record that orders text into a file still authorises its own measured delta": ruling record 7178358629 on #36882 (maintainer verbatim 「A 全部去掉，没配就灰」), term (5), orders "`Skills-docs:` a line that colour is declared via `color`", and its analysis names `skills/objectstack-ui` as the place. The row moves by the sentence's own measured delta (+62 tokens) and by no more.

## Acceptance notes

- Card acceptance 1, "colour on a select option badge appears only when the option declares `color` (family name or hex), and undeclared options render neutral": the sentence says it, with the family names as the renderer keys them.
- Card acceptance 2, "remove or correct any text that implies automatic colouring by value": 0 such lines in `skills/objectstack-ui` on the base commit.
- A declared `color` that is neither one of the nine names nor a `#` hex also renders neutral; the sentence's "any other option" covers it. The warning for that case is tracked on the #36882 line of work and is not part of this change.
- `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` is also edited by the open pull request 37947 (a different row); `overlap-check.mjs --pr=37947` answers "merges cleanly" against both `origin/main` and that head.
- Governed surface (`skills/**`): this pull request stays draft and is landed by its tier's record, not by its author.
